book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Kx Ayrnrngr Mz Timoti

content: Na-alvztrpzme mz lrmakxtr nem kx nakrka'-ngrgu leplz kcng tzaclveng drtc' amrlx x kxnzrmailz rgung amrlx. Murde na-aclve-angidrlr nigu x namnc-zpwxku mz nzamatq-krgu Gct, x mz nzvz-nqblq-krgu natqde. X nakrka'-ngrgu leplz amrlx, mz nzrlxti-krbzku mz Gct nzokatr-krde nidr. X na-awibzku bade mz nzayzlu-krde nzkrka'ngr lcng.
Gct kc tqarlapxle nigu abrtzlvzle nzkrka'-krgu leplz amrlx.
Murde suti drtwrde kx leplz amrlx narlapxng mz alwx ngrdrng x nakrlzlr nzalvztrngr angidr.

Murde nzalvztrngr angidr nide sele. Gct esz'txu. X Mevalu Jiszs ngi ncblo esz'txu Kc tqtu mz mzlir Gct x leplz. Murde rlrpx-lzbq mz nzbzo-krmle mz kros, mz nzxpe-krde alwx ngr leplz amrlx, mz nzvz-nqblq-krde mzli kc tqyrlq Gct.

Delc tqmcpxngr Gct ninge, mz nzyapwxtipx-krnge Nrpakxmrlz. Zpwxtx! Trpokiawxu! Mcpxle ninge mz nzngini-krnge aposol. X atwzlr-ngrde ninge mz nzalvztr-krnge krkcng trngiulrJiu, murde nalxngiti-kzlr nzalvztrngr angidr.

X suti zlwz drtwrnge kx ncblo neng Kraes ngr mrlcng amrlx nakrka'ng. Murde nzkrka'ngr atubxlzle nzwzkr Nrpakxmrlz. Bzkq ncblo nzbubzlr mqdr mz enqmi rdr, a' naglalzbzlr mqdr mz Gct mz nzkrka'ngr kxtr.

Suti kz drtwrnge kx olvz nakrka'-kzng mz nzavzo-lzbq-krbzlr mz Gct. X nakqng lrpz kx takitrde nzkrka'ngr. A' bzkq nzalulilr nrlardr kxyz mz nzkcmnzkr leplz nidr. X bzkq nzalqtilr da kxlqlwx mz nqnginardr, x nzrlung gol, x nzkqng lrpz kx trau rde kqlu zlwz, murde da kxnzmulr lcng nzatrkatilr leplz mz nzmnctr-krbzlr mz Kraes.
Murde takitrde olvz neng Kraes kx na-aelwapx-ngrdr nzamatq-krdr Gct nzalqngiti-krdr nabzdr mz nzrtrngz-krbzlr da kxmrlz.

Olvz kxnzlxngiting namnc-lrping mzli kc tzryapwxngr mz nzyrlwr-lxblrkr lr makxtr. X navz-nqblqlr nzalvztrngr lcng. Murde mzli kc Gct tqwz-ngrde nrlc, wz-ayrnr-ngrde Adzm, x Iv kc ate. Delc mz nzaclvengr lrmakxtr, tr-rlr-ngrpwc'u mz olvz nzalvztr-krdr ncblo mz dalr nzmncngr mz Kraes x bzkq zmatq ngrdr nzmyaszpx-krdr ncblo, a' ncblo namyapxpwz. X tr-rlr-ngrpwc'u mz olvz nzaclve-krdr ncblo mz nzka-krbzlr natq badr. Murde trngiu Adzm kc tqmailzle Iv mz alwx, a' Iv kc tqtao kai mz alwx, mz nzesabrtikr Setzn nide.

Kxmule-esz', a' tqngi olvz kc tqrmikapx Mevalu Kxnzmcpx, kc tqaovxiole Setzn. X mz nzrmikangr lc, olvz amrlx narlapx-kzng, mz nzlxngiti-zvz-krdr nide. Nzmnc-krdr natr x namrlzti-zvzlr leplz, x na-alelr da kxtubq.

footnotes.text: 2:11-14 Kzdung leplz nzrpilr kx natq Pol lcng takitrde olvz amrlx kxnzrlxngiting. A' kzdung nzrpilr kx trtingr, a' ngi txpwz natq kc tqkapxbzle mz lr Efiszs murde olvz lcng trnzkrlz-zwpxkalr nzalvztrngr angidr. 2:15 Kzdung leplz drtwrdr tresz'tiu mz da kc tztekqtr mz ngalrde 15. A' nzrpilr kx drtwr ngrde nide sele. ‘Kxmule-esz' alwx vz-ngrmle mz nrlc olvz, a' olvz narlapxng mz nzatutr-krdr nzwzkr olvz mz nzrmikangr doa x nzasu-krdr dakxnzng x kzdung kz da kxnzmulr lcng, nzmu navz zvz nzlxngiti-krdr Mevalu Kxnzmcpx mz nztrkr nzmnc-krdr, x nzmrlzti-krdr leplz, x nzale-krdr da kxtubq. A' bzkq nzvecpx-lzbqng mrkc tqamncngr Gct nidr, da kc tqwai Iv.’
